## Rule by liveness model
Which layer a probe must touch depends on the tool's liveness model:

- `needs-traffic` (a store that pauses after idle time, as Supabase does): the probe never queries the store; it stops at the application (issue:RTrentJones/RTrentJones.dev#55, pr:RTrentJones/greenlight#28; trace raw:20261101T090000Z-1a2b3c4d).
- `needs-silence` (a scale-to-zero store, as Neon is) and `needs-heal` (a reclaimable container): every healthcheck and keepalive must query the store without exception (commit:RTrentJones/RTrentJones.dev@16cee9a60db9a93d55567bd41d21378a193c0e42; trace raw:20261101T091500Z-5e6f7a8b).
- Readiness that does check the store stays on `/health`, which only verify calls at deploy time (commit:RTrentJones/RTrentJones.dev@16cee9a60db9a93d55567bd41d21378a193c0e42).

## Related
The probe half of this failure is the `needs-silence` branch of pattern/probe-touches-wrong-layer: a healthcheck or keepalive aimed at a store-querying route kept the compute awake (commit:RTrentJones/RTrentJones.dev@16cee9a60db9a93d55567bd41d21378a193c0e42).

# Wiki index

## Patterns
- [keepalive-probe-misses-postgres](patterns/keepalive-probe-misses-postgres.md) — hypothesis — a Supabase keepalive that never reaches Postgres.
- [neon-never-sleeps](patterns/neon-never-sleeps.md) — hypothesis — idle-time polling keeps a scale-to-zero compute awake.
- [probe-touches-wrong-layer](patterns/probe-touches-wrong-layer.md) — hypothesis — a probe must touch the layer its liveness model manages: the store for needs-traffic, the application for needs-silence and needs-heal.
